=== BEGIN ARTIFACT TOPOLOGY.md ===
## Declarations

## story foundation
summary:      Stand up the Python project tree, the root ledger launcher, and CLI dispatch.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   ARCHITECTURE.md
covers:       
accepts:      st-009
stack:        common.md, python.md, cli.md
provides:     ./ledger executable, cli.main
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Create the project tree with pyproject.toml and a committed uv.lock, the .venv created by uv venv,
  and the cli package exposing main(argv) -> int. Provide the executable ledger at the application
  root as a POSIX sh launcher that runs the cli package under .venv. Dispatch commands to handlers
  and map usage errors to exit code 2 with a diagnostic on standard error.

## story database
summary:      Declare the ledger store and generate the persistence package.
type:         foundational
kind:         migration
phase:        1
implements:   DATABASE.md
accepts:      st-009
depends:      foundation
stack:        persistence.md, sqlite.md, python.md
provides:     persistence.open_database, accounts, categories, transactions tables
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Declare the accounts, categories, and transactions tables with the columns and keys in
  INSTRUCTIONS.md. Amounts are INTEGER cents. Declare one access pattern per operation the feature
  stories use. Resolve the DSN from DATABASE_URL, then DATABASE_PATH, then data/app.db. Application
  code reaches the store only through the generated persistence package.

## story schema-init
summary:      Initialize the three-table schema with ledger init.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Schema-Init.md
covers:       SCHEMA-001
accepts:      st-003
depends:      database
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger init
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Drop and recreate accounts, categories, and transactions empty. Write nothing to standard output
  and exit 0. Exit 1 when the store is unreachable.

## story schema-count
summary:      Count rows per table with ledger count.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Schema-Count.md
covers:       SCHEMA-002
accepts:      st-003
depends:      schema-init
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger count
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Write the header table,rows then accounts, categories, transactions counts in that order, read
  from the database through a query.

## story cli-usage
summary:      Map unknown commands and wrong argument counts to exit code 2.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Cli-Usage.md
covers:       CLI-001
accepts:      st-001
depends:      foundation
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     usage error handling
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Any unknown command or wrong argument count exits 2 with one diagnostic line on standard error and
  nothing on standard output.

## story cli-reinit
summary:      Re-initialization drops every row.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Cli-Reinit.md
covers:       CLI-002
accepts:      st-003
depends:      schema-init
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  A second ledger init leaves all three tables at zero rows.

## story load-accounts
summary:      Load accounts from CSV with ledger load accounts.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Load-Accounts.md
covers:       LOAD-001
accepts:      st-004
depends:      schema-init
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger load accounts
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Load the four seed accounts from the CSV with the header matching accounts columns. Write
  table,loaded then accounts,4.

## story load-categories
summary:      Load categories from CSV with ledger load categories.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Load-Categories.md
covers:       LOAD-002
accepts:      st-004
depends:      schema-init
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger load categories
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Load the seven seed categories. Write table,loaded then categories,7.

## story load-transactions
summary:      Load transactions from CSV with ledger load transactions.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Load-Transactions.md
covers:       LOAD-003
accepts:      st-004, st-005
depends:      load-accounts, load-categories
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger load transactions
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Load the 120 seed transactions. Keep each txn_id from the file. Write table,loaded then
  transactions,120. A load into a non-empty table adds rows only when every row validates and no key
  collides.

## story load-atomic
summary:      Reject a load containing an invalid row atomically.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Load-Atomic.md
covers:       LOAD-004
accepts:      st-007, st-008
depends:      load-transactions
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  A load with an invalid row, including an unknown account, exits 3, writes nothing to standard
  output, emits one diagnostic line on standard error, and stores none of the rows.

## story load-duplicate
summary:      Reject a load whose keys collide with existing rows.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Load-Duplicate.md
covers:       LOAD-005
accepts:      st-007
depends:      load-accounts
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  A duplicate key exits 3 and leaves every table unchanged.

## story report-balances
summary:      Balances report by account, computed from the database.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Report-Balances.md
covers:       REPORT-001
accepts:      st-005
depends:      load-transactions
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger report balances
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Emit account,name,transactions,balance per account by code, then TOTAL,,count,sum. Compute every
  value from a query.

## story report-categories
summary:      Categories report with inflow, outflow, and net.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Report-Categories.md
covers:       REPORT-002
accepts:      st-005
depends:      load-transactions
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger report categories
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Emit a row per category by code, including categories with no transactions, then the TOTAL row.

## story report-monthly
summary:      Monthly report by YYYY-MM.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Report-Monthly.md
covers:       REPORT-003
accepts:      st-005
depends:      load-transactions
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger report monthly
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Emit a row per month that has transactions, ascending, then the TOTAL row.

## story report-unknown
summary:      Reject an unknown report name with exit code 2.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Report-Unknown.md
covers:       REPORT-004
accepts:      st-005
depends:      cli-usage
stack:        python.md, cli.md
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  An unknown report name exits 2 and writes nothing to standard output.

## story acct-add
summary:      Add an account with ledger account add.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Acct-Add.md
covers:       ACCT-001
accepts:      st-006, st-007
depends:      database, schema-init
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger account add
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Write the new account row. A duplicate code exits 3. Validate code and name before writing.

## story acct-get
summary:      Get an account with ledger account get.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Acct-Get.md
covers:       ACCT-002
accepts:      st-006
depends:      acct-add
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger account get
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Write the account row. An absent code exits 4.

## story acct-rename
summary:      Rename an account with ledger account rename.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Acct-Rename.md
covers:       ACCT-003
accepts:      st-006
depends:      acct-add
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger account rename
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Write the updated row. An absent code exits 4.

## story acct-delete
summary:      Delete an account with ledger account delete.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Acct-Delete.md
covers:       ACCT-004
accepts:      st-006, st-007
depends:      acct-add, txn-post
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger account delete
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Refuse with exit 3 while the account has transactions and leave it in place. Write deleted and the
  code on success. An absent code exits 4.

## story txn-post
summary:      Post a transaction with ledger txn post.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Txn-Post.md
covers:       TXN-001
accepts:      st-006, st-007, st-008
depends:      acct-add, load-categories
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger txn post
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Validate account, category, amount as integer cents, and date before any write. Assign id one more
  than the largest present, or 1 when empty. A balance that would go negative exits 3.

## story txn-get
summary:      Get a transaction with ledger txn get.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Txn-Get.md
covers:       TXN-002
accepts:      st-006
depends:      txn-post
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger txn get
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Write the transaction row. An absent id exits 4.

## story txn-amend
summary:      Amend a transaction amount with ledger txn amend.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Txn-Amend.md
covers:       TXN-003
accepts:      st-006, st-007, st-008
depends:      txn-post
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger txn amend
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Change only the amount. An absent id exits 4. An amount that leaves a balance negative exits 3 and
  changes nothing.

## story txn-delete
summary:      Delete a transaction with ledger txn delete.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Txn-Delete.md
covers:       TXN-004
accepts:      st-006, st-007, st-008
depends:      txn-post
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger txn delete
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Write deleted and the id on success. An absent id exits 4. A deletion that leaves a balance
  negative exits 3 and changes nothing.

## story transfer
summary:      Transfer between accounts with ledger transfer.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Transfer.md
covers:       XFER-001
accepts:      st-006, st-007, st-008
depends:      txn-post
context:      DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger transfer
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Write two TRANSFER rows, ids N and N+1, atomically. Reject equal accounts or a non-positive
  amount with exit 3. Reject a transfer that would leave either balance negative.

## story grader
summary:      Verify the completed ledger against the supplied grader and the application test suite.
type:         feature
kind:         test harness
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Grader-Verification.md
covers:       
accepts:      st-001, st-002
depends:      foundation, database, schema-init, schema-count, cli-usage, cli-reinit, load-accounts, load-categories, load-transactions, load-atomic, load-duplicate, report-balances, report-categories, report-monthly, report-unknown, acct-add, acct-get, acct-rename, acct-delete, txn-post, txn-get, txn-amend, txn-delete, transfer
stack:        common.md, python.md
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Terminal story. Provide bin/test.sh as a POSIX sh wrapper that runs pytest -q from the application
  root and exits 0 only on success. Run sh sources/run.sh from the application root as the terminal
  criterion. Do not modify anything under sources/.
=== END ARTIFACT ===
